spec.purpose: Combined/boundary screening of the larger nonlinear candidate; not a frozen training domain
spec.scope: Predeclared finite screen on unchanged cached meshes. New targets continue from corresponding saved old-box states; two selected targets are also reached independently from zero on each mesh. Two exact saved endpoints are reused with provenance. Physical screens are sampled, not stability/contact/uniqueness proofs; no new training data campaign or material law. Do not relax thresholds after viewing results.
